BiblicalUsage: The word names a bond or binding, and it appears once, when God asks Job whether he can bind the sweet influences of the Pleiades or loose the bands of Orion. The stars themselves are held in bonds only God can fasten or loose.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the bands of the stars remind me how small my power is and how great God's, because He ties what no man can untie.
